regionalSettings: en_CA; dollar prefix, decimal point, comma groups. Numeric currency syntax applies to the app’s en-US dollar setting; these cases contain no dates.
method: Read-only native Evaluate for VALUE(text), text+0, --text, SUM(text literal), ABS(text). Error results encode ERR plus ERROR.TYPE. Native worksheet controls also verify stored text and the same expressions after XLSX export. Two mixed-fraction percent cases differ from the app by one binary64 ULP; comparisons retain a one-ULP tolerance rather than introducing a fixture-specific rounding correction.
